adjudication.rationale: The diff clearly shows the same nested ternary being repeated across many call sites to coerce a scalar DB `destinationCalendar` into the new array-shaped `CalendarEvent.destinationCalendar` (e.g., bookingReminder.ts, webhook.ts, paypal-webhook.ts, handleCancelBooking.ts, confirm/editLocation/deleteCredential/requestReschedule handlers). The type change is also explicit (`destinationCalendar?: DestinationCalendar[] | null` in CalendarEvent types/class). At the same time, persistence still connects only the first element (`handleNewBooking.ts` uses `connect: { id: evt.destinationCalendar[0].id }`), evidencing an ongoing scalar DB relationship despite the domain now supporting arrays. This is a concrete maintainability/architecture issue created/exposed by the change (duplication + potential drift), even if it may not be an immediate functional break solely from the diff.
